task: Focused independent source/test review of ideal blackbody color and white adaptation
focus: Bradford adaptation direction and matrix usage

checks.method: Static source inspection and mathematical reasoning
checks.observation: Finite Kelvin is restricted to the inclusive 1000...20000 range. The fixed visible wavelength range and positive finite temperature bound keep the Planck denominator finite and positive. Endpoint trapezoid weights are present; the omitted constant 5 nm step cancels when dividing all channels by accumulated Y. The output is explicitly normalized by total.y after a finite-positive guard.

Tests assert Y=1 at 2856 K, approximate 2856 K and 6500 K xy expectations with declared 0.003 tolerance, and correctly distinguish a 6500 K blackbody from D65. These assertions were inspected, not executed.

checks.method: Static coefficient/direction review and algebraic reasoning
checks.observation: The code computes source and D65 target cone responses with the same Bradford matrix, checks positive source responses, uses destination/source ratios, and applies the inverse after componentwise scaling. For an XYZ vector proportional to the selected blackbody white, this maps to the same scalar times D65 up to the declared inverse coefficient precision. No reversed white-balance ratio or mismatched white reference was found.

The blackbody range is inclusive 1000...20000 K; preview white balance is intentionally narrower at 2000...10000 K. Tests include neutralization at both white-balance endpoints, light-color endpoints in the extreme-settings matrix, NaN/999 K blackbody rejection, and 10001 K preview-setting rejection. No boundary inconsistency was found within the scoped files.

Each normalized blackbody is weighted by independently computed lux before summation, so incident XYZ Y tracks total lux. The 18%/1000 reference is applied after summation, and preview white balance does not modify the measured totalLux. Tests express matched-white channel equality at 2000, 2856, 5600 and 10000 K, expected neutral-card brightness, unchanged lux after white-balance changes, and mixed-color XYZ additivity.

conclusion: No concrete actionable defect found in the assigned blackbody/white-adaptation scope.
limitations: Remote source/test inspection only; host unavailable. No shell scripts, Swift tests, agent_cycle checks, builds, numerical execution, CI execution or runtime claims.
Source review does not establish that any inspected test passes at this revision or independently promote M02/M03 acceptance.
Display tone mapping, gamut compression and exposure mapping were excluded because separately assigned.
No physical spectral/color calibration, camera profiling, device or Metal validation was performed.
No source, tree, branch or ref changes were made; the sole write is this authorized unreferenced evidence blob.
